note: Use induction on |X| with tight-set/strict-slack split. Necessity maps S injectively to matched Y-endpoints. Tight A: induct on G[A,N(A)] and G[X\A,Y\N(A)], deriving complementary Hall from A union T. No tight proper A: choose xy, delete x,y; every nonempty proper T has integer slack at least one, so Hall survives deleting y.
